newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia coffee group restates 10.4 mln bag crop.
newsitem.headline: Colombia coffee group restates 10.4 mln bag crop.

text.p: A spokesman for Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation said a forecast of 8.3 million 60-kg bags for the 1996/97 coffee year was based on an erroneous calculation and reiterated previous forecasts of 10.4 million bags.

"The calculation was wrong," said Roman Medina, explaining that he failed to take into account 2 million bags of January to March production. He said production for the coffee year was still seen at a level of about 10.4 million bags, down from 12.9 million in the 1995/96 coffee year.
A fax sent by a private export company to local news services following a meeting with federation chiefs Monday added to the confusion.

The fax quoted federation officials as saying April-September production was seen at 6.5 million bags. Medina said Wednesday estimated production for that period would actually be 2 million bags lower at 4.5 million bags.
Federation general manager Jorge Cardenas could not be reached for immediate comment on the miscalculation, which wreaked havoc with world markets.
